_meta.source: HCES 2023-24-shaped synthetic sample (factsheet rural MPCE anchor)
_meta.note: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER DATA. See data/sample/README.md. Not for citation. The all-India rural MPCE anchor of ₹4,122 is from the published HCES 2023-24 factsheet; the per-category shares below are illustrative until the microdata (catalogue 237) is approved.
_meta.method_note: MVP uses a state mean ± coefficient of variation to emit a band. PLAN.md §3 Model ② replaces this with Fay-Herriot small-area estimation.

tea_stall.addressable_rationale: The published group mixes home consumption bought through kiranas with out-of-home tea, snacks and prepared food; a village tea stall earns only the out-of-home and fresh-preparation fraction, so the addressable share stays well below the group total.

vegetable_vendor.addressable_rationale: Rural households self-grow part of their vegetables, and fruit partly moves through weekly haats; a resident vendor sells the purchased, non-haat fraction of this basket. This is the business the kirana rationale explicitly excludes from its own basket.

beauty_parlour.addressable_rationale: The group bundles several personal services (laundry, barber, tailoring, repairs, grooming); a beauty parlour earns only the grooming fraction, which is why the addressable share stays low. Tailoring draws on the same group with its own share.
